events.publisher: Department of Commerce / Government Publishing Office
events.sourceTitle: Federal Register notice 2026-20384: Methionine antidumping review results
events.summary: The Department of Commerce published final results of its first five-year reviews of existing methionine antidumping duty orders for France, Japan and Spain. It found that revoking the orders would likely lead to continued or recurring dumping. The notice states that the results apply from October 5, 2026.
events.supports: The complete notice establishes publication and applicability on October 5, 2026 and final results concerning existing orders. Signature and filing dates are separate. The listed margins describe the dumping likely if orders were revoked, not new tariff or cash-deposit rates. Full product scope is referred to a memorandum not reviewed here. Conflicting June initiation-date references are omitted. France, Japan and Spain are explicit relevance associations, not event locations.
events.title: Final methionine antidumping review results for France, Japan and Spain

events.publisher: Office of the United States Trade Representative / Government Publishing Office
events.sourceTitle: Federal Register notice 2026-20341: North American trade agreement consultation
events.summary: The Office of the United States Trade Representative announced consultation on operation of the United States-Mexico-Canada Agreement before its 2027 annual joint review. Written comments and hearing requests are due January 12, 2027, at 11:59 p.m. Eastern Standard Time. The hearing date and location will be announced separately.
events.supports: Complete official document reviewed. The Federal Register header establishes publication on October 5, 2026; the October 2 filing timestamp is separate. The notice establishes a consultation and comment deadline, not a treaty amendment or new trade restriction. Canada and Mexico are relevance associations, not physical event locations. No later hearing notice was reviewed.
events.title: Consultation opens before the 2027 North American trade review
